thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: HOSTED-EU inference-service high latency (eu-west-1). Escalation policy: hosted-inference-primary. Page sent to primary oncall (Sara) at 2025-11-03T03:21:40Z.
PagerDuty: Escalation: primary did not acknowledge within 2m -> paging secondary (Mike).
Sara: on it, seeing an influx of 5xxs and token queue latency on a few pods. digging.
Mike: got a page too — my phone was in DND, sorry. jumping in now.
Anita: reported by a customer: several requests timing out in EU region. Could be autoscaler lag?
Jordan: adding logs from edge LB: 
```
[2025-11-03T03:20:32Z] upstream_timeout svc-inference-eu-01 502 120s
[2025-11-03T03:20:44Z] queue_length svc-inference-eu-01 78
[2025-11-03T03:21:10Z] cpu_usage node-gpu-eu-03 94%
```
Sara: kubectl top shows GPU nodes spiking, HPA didn't scale because pod resource requests are pinned. suspect spike + cold-starts for model shards.
Mike: PagerDuty says escalation already fired to manager because secondary didn't ack in time. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
PagerDuty: Escalation: secondary unacked -> paging manager (Lena).
Lena (oncall-mgr): I got the manager page. what's the current customer impact?
Anita: approx 7 customers affected (embedding + generation calls), error rate ~18% over last 5m, tail latency >30s.
Jordan: here's the `kubectl get pods` dump: 
```
NAMESPACE   NAME                             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference   model-server-0                   1/1     Running   0          12d
inference   model-server-1                   0/1     NotReady  3          3m
inference   model-server-2                   0/1     CrashLoop 5          4m
```
Sara: I triggered a soft-silence in PagerDuty for the policy to stop more escalations while we triage. `pd silence add --id hosted-inference-policy --duration 30m`
Mike: good call. I'm seeing a stuck init container on model-server-2 referencing missing NFS mount. Could be a storage outage in eu-west-1 zone-b.
Anita: can we fail traffic to eu-west-2 as short-term mitigation? Will increase latency for EU customers but reduce errors.
Jordan: routing change possible, but need a deploy-window for config. I can flip a LB weight to eu-west-2 now for a portion (20%) to test.
Lena (oncall-mgr): do it. start with 20% and monitor. notify customers when threshold reached.
Sara: scaling plan: spin up 2 spare shards in eu-west-2 and route 20% there. commands: 
```
# scale nodes
kubectl scale nodegroup gpu-pool-eu --replicas=5 --region eu-west-2
# bump model replicas
kubectl scale deployment model-server --replicas=6 -n inference
```
Mike: launching now. also replacing the Faulty NFS mount by restarting the CSI driver on node-gpu-eu-03: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/csi-driver -n kube-system`
IncidentBot: :information_source: Silence created for escalation policy hosted-inference-policy by Sara for 30m.
PagerDuty: Note: manager was paged due to secondary missing ack; manager acknowledged at 2025-11-03T03:26:03Z.
Lena (oncall-mgr): acknowledged. thanks — keep me posted on customer impact and ETA for full recovery.
Anita: monitoring dashboard shows successful reduction in 5xx to ~6% after traffic shift began at 03:27Z. tail latency down to 4s for routed traffic.
Jordan: nodes in eu-west-2 up and model replicas healthy. continuing to flush queued requests.
Sara: the NFS provider in eu-west-1 shows transient errors at zone-b — opened ticket with infra team to investigate underlying storage.
Mike: restarted CSI driver on the affected node; model-server-2 container came back up. I'm running a small smoke test against the pod: `curl -sS http://model-server-2:8080/health` -> 200 OK.
Anita: customer impact timeline to communicate: 03:20Z — spike starts; 03:21Z — PagerDuty alert fired and escalation chain began; 03:27Z — partial traffic shift; 03:31Z — majority of affected pods recovered; 03:34Z — errors back to baseline.
Lena (oncall-mgr): draft customer message: "We experienced an elevated error rate for hosted inference in eu-west-1 between ~03:20–03:34 UTC due to a transient storage issue causing model pods to fail to initialize. We shifted traffic and restored services; no data loss. We're investigating root cause and follow-up." approve?
Sara: approve. send to customers.
Mike: adding incident tags and will open a Postmortem PR. notes: consider making HPA responsive to queue_length metric and add NFS mount health probe to avoid this class of crashloop.
Jordan: also recommend temporary override to prevent PagerDuty cascading to manager for duplicate page conditions when silences are created quickly — race between bot and silence creation.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty silence ended at 2025-11-03T03:57:40Z (30m).
Lena (oncall-mgr): thanks everyone. I'll follow up with infra / storage team and drive postmortem.
Sara: good job coordinating. closing thread when PR and postmortem link are posted. :thumbsup:
Mike: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/incident-postmortems/pull/234
Anita: adding retrospective notes to the incident board.
Jordan: tagging infra: @infra-team for storage investigation.
IncidentBot: thread archived by Sara.
